 Ford Recalls 30,000 F-Series Vehicles
 Vehicles Affected: Ford is recalling 30,000 Ford F-Series pickups, including model-year 2026 F-250, F-350 and F-450 Super Duty trucks, as well as 2026-27 F-150s.
 The Problem: According to the automaker, the left-side tailgate cable may fail under heavy loads, allowing the tailgate to drop on the rear bumper and increase the risk of injury.
 The Fix: Dealers will replace the affected cable for free. Owners will be notified about the safety risk by Dec. 14.
 Image Source: Ford Recalls 30,000 F-Series Pickups for Tailgate Issue | Cars.com 
 2022-24 Lexus NX, NX Hybrid & NX Plug-in Hybrid SUVs
 Vehicles Affected: Parent company Toyota is recalling more than 63,300 Lexus vehicles, including model-year 2022-24 NX, NX Hybrid and NX Plug-in Hybrid SUVs.
 The Problem: According to the automaker, the 7-inch instrument display may go partially blank during startup, failing to display certain warnings or indicators, such as engine oil pressure, engine coolant temperature or electrical charge to the driver.
 The Fix: Dealers will update the combination meter software for free. Toyota will begin sending notification letters to owners on Dec. 7.
 Image Source: 63,000-Plus Lexus NX SUVs Recalled Over Instrument Panel Display | Cars.com 
 2022-26 Land Rover Range Rover
 Vehicles Affected: Land Rover is recalling more than 93,900 model-year 2022-26 Range Rovers.
 The Problem: According to the automaker, the rearview camera may not have sufficient drain holes, thereby preventing water from being able to drain away from the camera. As a result, the accumulated water may cause damage to the rearview camera and prevent it from displaying an image behind the vehicle, thereby decreasing the driver’s rear visibility and increasing the risk of a crash.
 The Fix: Dealers will drill additional drain holes in the underside of the tailgate trim, plus inspect and replace the rearview camera as necessary and for free. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed Dec. 11.
 Image Source: 94,000 Land Rover Range Rovers Recalled for Rearview Cameras | Cars.com 
 Ford Recalls 102,000 F-Series Pickup Trucks
 Vehicles Affected: Ford is recalling more than 102,100 F-Series pickup trucks, including model-year 2025-26 Super Duty F-250, F-350, F-450, F-550 and F-600 trucks, as well as model-year 2026 F-150s and Super Duty F-750s.
 The Problem: According to the automaker, the tachometer and speedometer in the instrument panel may become stuck or move erratically and provide inaccurate readings.
 The Fix: Dealers will replace the instrument cluster modules for free. Interim letters notifying owners of the issue were expected to be mailed Oct. 26.
 Image Source: Ford Recalls 102,000-Plus F-Series Pickups for Speedometer Issue | Cars.com 
 2015-16 Genesis and 2017-20 Genesis G80 Sedans
 Vehicles Affected: Parent automaker Hyundai is recalling more than 94,600 model-year 2015-16 Genesis and 2017-20 Genesis G80 sedans.
 The Problem: According to the automaker, the front power seat may overheat due to a stuck power-seat control switch, thereby increasing the risk of a fire while parked or driving.
 The Fix: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outside and away from other vehicles or structures until repaired. Hyundai will begin notifying owners on Dec. 7.
 Image Source: 94,000 Hyundai, Genesis Sedans Recalled for Fire Risk | Cars.com 
 2024-27 Toyota Land Cruisers
 Vehicles Affected: Toyota is recalling approximately 106,000 model-year 2024-27 Land Cruisers.
 The Problem: According to the automaker, the fuel tube near the fuel tank could become disconnected and allow fuel to leak until the engine in the hybrid system turns off.
 The Fix: Dealers will inspect the connection and install a supplemental clamp to prevent the fuel tube from disconnecting, or replace the resin fuel tube and install the clamp. Owners will be notified by mid-December.
 Image Source: Toyota Recalls 106,000 Land Cruiser SUVs for Fire Risk | Cars.com
